2610.18861.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
2610.18861.review: Latent reasoning cuts agent tokens 35-55%, but only via RL fine-tuning of open models; code at togethercomputer/HybridAgent, no weights.

2610.31642.title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
2610.31642.review: Corrected low-precision softmax/CE and soft-target distillation loss; toy experiments only; relevant only if writing custom bf16 distillation losses.

2610.28480.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model

2610.18773.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
2610.18773.review: Permutation-invariant option scorer with null outcome; beats Jev-1.13.0 (likely decide's lineage) on BANKING77 K=8 92.05 vs 86.14, null AUROC 98.7 vs 93.6. No weights stated in paper; possible BANKING77 contamination. Test head-to-head vs decide on Typed Decisions + BANKING77; borrow coverage gate and cached per-option K/V.

2610.08144.title: Navier-Stokes lost in translation
2610.08144.review: Lean verification of autoformalised proofs does not validate the informal proof; no engineering content.

2610.06805.title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
2610.06805.review: Hierarchical action-conditioned JEPA world models for top-down visual planning (AntMaze 73% vs 18% flat); simulation-only, H200-scale training, no bearing on his stack.

2610.06833.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
2610.06833.review: Looped 1.6B ~1/3 the weight bytes of equal-depth untied at equal FLOPs; terminal KV sharing 3x smaller cache at <=0.85% ppl. No checkpoints; gains within seed noise. Code ifm-ai/xllm-loop.

2610.29162.title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
2610.29162.review: Frontier models overuse psycholinguistically hard constructions; descriptive, nothing to adopt.

2610.30136.title: Agentic World Action Models
2610.30136.review: Robot manipulation model generating skill code + video + actions.

2610.13928.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
2610.13928.review: Encrypted capability lockers survive SFT/LAT/GCG; supply-chain threat, no tested mitigation. Clean evals of open-weight models cannot rule out hidden triggers.

2610.26825.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
2610.26825.review: Memory-in-weights trails same-backbone DenseRAG by 9.5 pts avg (LongMemEval 32.6 vs 70.8) -- supports external memory design. Code MemTensor/MemT-1.0, HF collection MemTensor/memt-1.

2610.10528.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models

2610.11959.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
2610.11959.review: RL scaling tech report; mentions MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B but no release link found.

2610.18615.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
2610.18615.review: Video interval/MC scoring with shared-prefix caching; no video pipeline in stack.

2610.06783.title: Truly Subquadratic 3SUM and Truly Subcubic APSP via Triangles in Sparse Lopsided Graphs
2610.06783.review: Complexity theory; authors call it impractical.

2610.22471.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
2610.22471.review: Robotics eval of a closed model.

2610.20533.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
2610.20533.review: Image latent tokenizer from diffusion PMI; not text retrieval. Code AlanBaade/repr.

2610.32285.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
2610.32285.review: 7-part harness taxonomy as audit checklist; 31% of task successes violate a harness criterion. Code TraceLite-AI/TraceTrial-Bench.

2610.24087.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
2610.24087.review: Infeasible deliveries are most of the gap to experts; reinforces hard-constraint checks before agent delivery.

2610.08077.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation
2610.08077.review: RLVR training add-on; prompt-only variant showed little effect.

2610.14224.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
2610.14224.review: Per-task harness-edit loop (generic + domain edit, probe, compose, distill into a library) with code at github.com/google-research/harness2; GLM-5/OpenCode on WorkBuddy-Bench 64.2 to 75.7, though only ~1 point over offline Meta-Harness and LLM-judged over 3 runs. Its component model (always-on prose is paid every run, skills need a trigger line, hooks enforce what prose can't) maps directly onto Claude Code skills/hooks and Muninn boot design.

2610.39302.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
2610.39302.review: Proves separately trained JEPAs converge up to a rotation when positives are views of one scene; a 109M text JEPA reaches 0.184 mutual-kNN with DINOv2 vs 0.154 for Qwen2.5-72B, but on one benchmark with LLaVA recaptions. Code at github.com/galilai-group/prh-proof; the one-GPU Flickr recipe and pair-free Procrustes alignment between embedding spaces are testable, and it argues for building embedder positives as different descriptions of the same item.

2610.19159.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
2610.19159.review: 15 open research directions, 135 agent submissions, none valid under strict grading and 114 failing integrity. The audited failure modes (lenient self-verification 58/64, too little backtracking 34/64) reinforce checking agent artifacts against the original plan rather than the agent's own checker; nothing new to adopt.

2610.35845.title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
2610.35845.review: 91-page survey of agents as model plus harness in stateful workspaces; no results of its own. Worth borrowing: the attempted/accepted/committed/verified effect-state distinction for tool calls, and keeping changing facts in external records rather than weights.

2610.28577.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
2610.28577.review: Drops selected KV entries inside a custom SGLang engine (AKV) for ~28% cost savings vs summarization; hosted APIs don't expose this. Design warning: text-level trimming of old tool outputs without cache control cost 1.85x full context, since it breaks prefix caching.

2610.14709.title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
2610.14709.review: Fine-tunes on tasks labeled by users' observed future behavior from a proprietary 100k-user log, judged by a 2.4T model; not reproducible. The task construction (hold out a future window as label, keep mid-difficulty tasks) could seed a personal-context eval from memory or Strava logs.

2610.12242.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
2610.12242.review: Serving runtime for token-level small/large routing; realistic gain ~1.7x over the large model alone, not the 64x headline. Needs self-hosted model pairs with logit access, which Muninn's hosted-API routing lacks.

2610.14162.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
2610.14162.review: Residual VQ code hierarchy lets a ~100M model generate text in 8-12 parallel steps vs 128 for diffusion LMs; per-dataset training from scratch, nothing to drop into the browser stack yet.

2610.12369.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
2610.12369.review: Coding agents write a model-free robot policy library that hits 70% on RoboDojo sim vs 31% leaderboard best, but it is hand-engineered against simulator state. The explicit-state, default-off-parameter code pattern is the only transferable piece.

2610.20331.title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
2610.20331.review: Reconstruction pretraining then OT fine-tuning gives one-step ImageNet FID 1.19 at a fraction of Drifting's compute; image-generation training on 8 H200s, no decision for his work.

2610.14136.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
2610.14136.review: Corrector network refines diffusion predictions each step, beating CFG on DiT/SiT unguided FID; image-diffusion only.

2610.05538.title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers
2610.05538.review: Looped DiT core can run more loops than trained, with fewer params; ImageNet diffusion only, no evidence for language or embedding models.

2610.10515.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
2610.10515.review: Robot latent world-model scaling laws on 2.87M trajectories with real Franka tests; cluster-scale robotics, no overlap with his work.

2610.20424.title: BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
2610.20424.review: 50-task stateful payments-workflow agent benchmark with a released harness and dataset (github.com/ant-intl/BizBench, now BizAgentBench); Claude Opus 5 strict success 64.0%. The findings that carry over to subagent delegation: a tool-call cap of 2x the reference trace cuts DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash strict success from 43.3% to 26.7%, so tight turn budgets are costly; and outcome-only checks miss process violations such as crossing a reserve floor or acting before approval. Giving the agent the customer's constraints up front (70.0%) beat giving it gold docs (50.0%). Domain is far from Muninn and runs are few (1-3 per model).

2610.12176.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
2610.12176.review: MASS alternates evolutionary search over orchestrator/subagent workflow prompts (roles, handoffs, call order), self-judged by Qwen3.6-27B, with LoRA SFT on the resulting traces; code at github.com/SakanaAI/mass. The prompt-level workflow search is the transferable part for Muninn's subagent delegation, and the paper finds workflow optimisation rather than evaluation is the bottleneck. Win rate vs base rises 53.9% to 69.9% on frontier-judged private synthetic tasks, but Terminal-Bench 2.0 (37.5 to 35.2) and SWE-bench Verified (62.6 to 61.1) regress, and the 1.2-1.6x headline is score per output token, so test it on his own tasks first.

2610.40564.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
2610.40564.review: Recasts MaxRL-style RL as weighted maximum likelihood so pretraining, SFT and RL run as one mixed-data loss; shown at 124M and 0.76B scale, code and weights released. A training-recipe paper that needs a pretraining budget; the one portable note is that replaying ~0.5-5% earlier-stage data during fine-tuning reduced forgetting.

2610.37381.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
2610.37381.review: Robot-manipulation VLA with a physical-dynamics token module distilled from a video world model; gains of 0.2-0.9 points over copied, unrerun baselines and no code or weights. Nothing transfers to his stack.

2610.11765.title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
2610.11765.review: Native no-thinking modes yield answer-only output on Boolean tasks but almost never on open-ended ones; strict answer-only prompting on open-ended tasks raises empty-thinking to ~40% at a cost of ~15 accuracy points (spot-checked in the body). For cheap-model gates and subagent calls, frame the question as a closed answer set rather than suppressing reasoning on open questions. No code released.

2610.36848.title: Evolving Agent Teams
2610.36848.review: A supervisor restructures a Claude Code agent team on plateaus; gains (0.74x vs 0.51x of FlashInfer on MLA decode) are GPU-kernel-specific, all-Opus, two runs, no cost axis. Transferable bit: a mandated cross-team synthesis doc every subagent reads. Code: github.com/caoshiyi/EAT.

2610.13912.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
2610.13912.review: A small calibrated predictor reranks candidate patches/actions before execution; on CodeContests it lifts hidden-test success 26.0% -> 29.2% over random (CI +0.17 to +5.50), with gains elsewhere within noise. Amounts to reranking that the existing decide tool already covers.

2610.36077.title: The Trinity: Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
2610.36077.review: Evolves module-based agent harnesses per capability node and routes tasks with an LLM router that retrieves similar past outcomes; the commit-rationale/retrieve-outcomes/write-back loop could be tried on Muninn's model routing. Gains rest on a frozen frontier backbone and roughly 400-580M tokens of evolution per configuration, and the router saves only about 9% tokens over random routing. Repo: github.com/InfRec-Cardinal/The-Trinity.

2610.20442.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
2610.20442.review: Survey and taxonomy of agentic robotics with no experiments of its own. Sec. 7.6 describes code proposing legal candidates and a fast decision model (it cites TypeSafe's Jev) picking one above a confidence threshold, which matches the existing decide-based routing and changes nothing.
